sellable_metric: net expectancy = (Pwin*AvgWin) - (Ploss*AvgLoss), after costs, per trade

how_it_trades.entry: next session OPEN after a kept pattern fires at close
how_it_trades.exit: target touch within hold window (daily H/L) else time-exit at close
how_it_trades.selection: trade only patterns with positive <=2024 net expectancy
